description: Read an Ohmstead project file (.ohmstead text). With project_id it goes over that project: components, subsystems and wires keep their ids by tag, so saved positions and embeds survive. Without apply it only reports what would change (always do that first and show the user); apply=true saves. Without project_id it makes a new project named title (Free plan: max 3). Parts resolve by id, then by maker and number; anything missing or ambiguous is named and nothing is saved.

team.description: Team or class for a new project. Omit for your personal workspace.

title.description: Name for a new project (without project_id).

name: import_project_file
title: Import project file
